_about: Roster audit report shape (List 22 #208). The audit is a derived report: regenerated at each run from the species records + #197 lock provenance + #14's registry entry count. It assigns nothing, edits nothing, stores nothing. A run is cited only with its inputs' state on its face.
consumers: landing checks (a PR claiming a lock/number is checked against a fresh run)
design lane (the null register is the unlock queue, read)
inputs: species records (id: null until lock; lock provenance text on the record at lock)
open_slots: the audit's repo home + run mechanism (landing chooses — UNVERIFIED, see STAGING)
proposals_out: #156: an unnumbered species cannot headline a promo (proposed into #156's home; silhouette-teaser use unnamed/unnumbered is not barred)

gap_findings.detail: <the fact as found — the audit reports; the owner/data lane disposes>

locked_register.lock_provenance: <who/when/on what approval — read from the record>

presentation_readiness.current_design_of_record: present | MISSING (a number with no silhouette — #207 cannot derive one)

stat_number_state.stat_numbers: assigned | unassigned_flagged (owner/game-design class — reported, never filled by the audit)

run_cadence: at every landing touching roster data
